tps.bug: The new test-gcal-webhooks.sh writes GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL to '../.env' relative to the current directory, so running it from the repo root creates/edits a .env above the repo and the app never sees the URL.
tps.evidenciaOpus: scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh:5 sets ENV_FILE="../.env", resolved against the caller's working directory; lines 61-70 then create/edit that file. Run from the repo root (./scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh) it writes GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL to a .env outside the repo, so the app never picks it up.
tps.evidenciaAstra: The new script sets ENV_FILE="../.env" at scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh:5 and writes to that path at lines 62–70 without changing directories. Running it from the repository root therefore updates the parent directory’s .env, whereas apps/web/next.config.js:1 loads the repository’s .env, leaving the application's webhook configuration unchanged.
